description:
This light & airy split level furnished 2 bedroom maisonette on The Mall is right at the heart of Clifton Village and the plethora of shops and restaurants on your doorstep.  Would suit 2 professional sharers wanting spacious accommodation.  Two double bedrooms, large open plan lounge/diner through to kitchen, shower room, gas central heating.

Clifton Village - Live Beautifully in Clifton Village

Experience the perfect blend of elegance and energy in Clifton Village, Bristol’s most sought-after neighbourhood. With stunning Georgian architecture, independent cafés and boutiques, and breathtaking views of the Clifton Suspension Bridge, it’s a place where city life meets village charm.

Ideal for renters seeking style, convenience, and community — all just minutes from the city centre
